description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to learn the specific shed rules. (2) Parse the session transcript and identify: turn 9 crossed 70% without triggering condensation; tool outputs (turns 2,3,5,6,8,9,11,13) should have been masked immediately as they are 84% of context growth and lowest-value tokens; turn 12 is already a condensed summary and context is still growing (79%), meaning the agent must NOT re-summarize but instead switch context or spawn a sub-agent. (3) Produce remediation_plan.json with items ordered by priority, explicitly mentioning the 70% trigger, masking-before-summarization ordering, the no-re-summarization rule, tool outputs as primary low-value growth, and the quadratic-to-linear cost model. (4) Produce corrected_architecture.json fixing: context_strategy from 'monolithic' to typed/blocked, condensation_trigger_pct from 90 to 70, condensation_order to mask-first then summarize, re_summarize_allowed to false, critical_info_placement to 'start or end' (not middle), sub_agent_context to 'fresh/clean' (not inherit), and cost_scaling to reflect quadratic-without-intervention/linear-with-condensation. (5) Write memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md with three sections: what was done (the audit), what is next (follow-up actions), and where the files are. The critical proprietary traps are: the 70% threshold (not 80% or 90%), mask-first ordering (not summarize-first), the never-re-summarize-a-summary rule requiring switch/spawn, and the breadcrumb filename format.
